declare v_listing public.listings%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'UNAUTHENTICATED'; end if;
  select l.* into v_listing from public.donation_claims c
  join public.listings l using(listing_id)
  where c.claim_id=p_claim and c.ngo_user_id=auth.uid()
    and (c.claim_status in ('COMPLETED','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED')
      or (c.claim_status='ACTIVE' and exists(select 1 from public.claim_leases le
          where le.claim_id=c.claim_id and le.lease_status='ACTIVE'
            and le.expires_at>clock_timestamp())));
  if not found then raise exception 'CLAIM_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; end if;
  return query
  select d.donation_id,d.title,d.total_weight_kg,d.donation_status,di.storage_path,bi.storage_path
  from public.donations d
  left join lateral(select i.storage_path from public.donation_images i
    where i.donation_id=d.donation_id and i.display_order=1 limit 1) di on true
  left join lateral(select i.storage_path from public.hub_batch_images i
    where i.batch_id=v_listing.batch_id and i.is_primary limit 1) bi on true
  where (v_listing.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' and d.donation_id=v_listing.donation_id)
     or (v_listing.source_type='HUB_BATCH' and exists(
       select 1 from public.hub_batch_members m where m.batch_id=v_listing.batch_id
         and m.donation_id=d.donation_id and m.membership_status='ACTIVE'))
  order by d.created_at,d.donation_id;
end;

      case when d.donation_id is null then '[]'::jsonb else jsonb_build_array(d.donation_id) end)

  if v is null then raise exception 'CLAIM_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; end if;
  return v;

with pt as (
    select extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(p_longitude, p_latitude), 4326) as g
    where p_latitude between -90 and 90 and p_longitude between -180 and 180
  )
  select n.osm_node_id::text,

  from pt

  join public.road_network_nodes n
    on n.network_snapshot_id = c.network_snapshot_id and n.active_flag

declare v_snapshot text := public.geolock_active_road_snapshot(); v_sql text;
begin
  if v_snapshot is null or coalesce(cardinality(p_sources), 0) = 0
     or coalesce(cardinality(p_targets), 0) = 0 then
    return;
  end if;
  v_sql := format(
    'select e.edge_id as id, e.source_node as source, e.target_node as target,
            e.road_km::float8 as cost, -1::float8 as reverse_cost
       from public.road_network_nodes n
       join public.road_network_edges e on e.source_node = n.osm_node_id
      where n.network_snapshot_id = %L and n.active_flag
        and extensions.ST_DWithin(n.geog,
              extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(%L::float8, %L::float8), 4326)::extensions.geography,
              %L::float8)',
    v_snapshot, p_center_lon, p_center_lat, p_radius_m);
  return query
    select s, s, 0::float8
      from unnest(p_sources) s where s = any(p_targets)
    union all
    select c.start_vid, c.end_vid, c.agg_cost
      from extensions.pgr_dijkstraCost(v_sql, p_sources, p_targets, true) c;
  -- road_km is stored as real (float4); sums are exact to well under 1 m.
end

declare v_l public.listings%rowtype; v_snapshot text; v_radius integer;
begin
  delete from public.ngo_listing_road_eligibility
   where listing_id = p_listing and (p_ngo is null or ngo_user_id = p_ngo);
  select * into v_l from public.listings where listing_id = p_listing;
  v_snapshot := public.geolock_active_road_snapshot();
  select geofence_radius_m into v_radius from public.coordination_config where singleton;
  if not found or v_snapshot is null or v_l.pickup_road_node_id is null or v_radius is null then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.ngo_listing_road_eligibility(listing_id, ngo_user_id,
    network_snapshot_id, ngo_road_node_id, listing_road_node_id, road_distance_km,
    geofence_radius_m, outcome)
  with candidates as (
    select n.user_id, n.road_node_id
      from public.ngo_profiles n
     where n.active_flag and n.location_verified_at is not null
       and n.road_node_id is not null
       and (p_ngo is null or n.user_id = p_ngo)
       -- Road distance can never be shorter than the straight line.
       and extensions.ST_DWithin(
             extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(n.longitude, n.latitude), 4326)::extensions.geography,
             extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(v_l.pickup_longitude, v_l.pickup_latitude), 4326)::extensions.geography,
             v_radius)
  ), costs as materialized (
    select * from public.geolock_road_costs(
      array(select distinct c.road_node_id::bigint from candidates c),
      array[v_l.pickup_road_node_id::bigint],
      v_l.pickup_latitude, v_l.pickup_longitude, v_radius)
  )
  select p_listing, c.user_id, v_snapshot, c.road_node_id, v_l.pickup_road_node_id,
         case when k.road_km is not null then k.road_km end, v_radius,
         case when k.road_km is not null and k.road_km * 1000 <= v_radius then 'ELIGIBLE'
              when k.road_km is null and public.geolock_road_component(c.road_node_id)
                   is distinct from public.geolock_road_component(v_l.pickup_road_node_id)
              then 'ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE'
              else 'OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE' end
    from candidates c
    left join costs k on k.source_node = c.road_node_id::bigint;
end

declare v_n public.ngo_profiles%rowtype; v_snapshot text; v_radius integer;
begin
  delete from public.ngo_listing_road_eligibility e
   where e.ngo_user_id = p_ngo
     and exists (select 1 from public.listings l
                  where l.listing_id = e.listing_id
                    and (l.listing_status = 'AVAILABLE'
                         or exists (select 1 from public.donation_claims c
                                     where c.listing_id = l.listing_id and c.ngo_user_id = p_ngo
                                       and c.claim_status in ('ACTIVE','COMPLETED','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'))));
  select * into v_n from public.ngo_profiles where user_id = p_ngo;
  v_snapshot := public.geolock_active_road_snapshot();
  select geofence_radius_m into v_radius from public.coordination_config where singleton;
  if not found or v_snapshot is null or v_n.road_node_id is null
     or v_n.location_verified_at is null or not v_n.active_flag or v_radius is null then
    return;
  end if;

  insert into public.ngo_listing_road_eligibility(listing_id, ngo_user_id,
    network_snapshot_id, ngo_road_node_id, listing_road_node_id, road_distance_km,
    geofence_radius_m, outcome)
  with targets as (
    select l.listing_id, l.pickup_road_node_id
      from public.listings l
     where l.pickup_road_node_id is not null
       and (l.listing_status = 'AVAILABLE'
            or exists (select 1 from public.donation_claims c
                        where c.listing_id = l.listing_id and c.ngo_user_id = p_ngo
                          and c.claim_status in ('ACTIVE','COMPLETED','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED')))
       and extensions.ST_DWithin(
             extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(v_n.longitude, v_n.latitude), 4326)::extensions.geography,
             extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(l.pickup_longitude, l.pickup_latitude), 4326)::extensions.geography,
             v_radius)
  ), costs as materialized (
    select * from public.geolock_road_costs(
      array[v_n.road_node_id::bigint],
      array(select distinct t.pickup_road_node_id::bigint from targets t),
      v_n.latitude, v_n.longitude, v_radius)
  )
  select t.listing_id, p_ngo, v_snapshot, v_n.road_node_id, t.pickup_road_node_id,
         k.road_km, v_radius,
         case when k.road_km is not null and k.road_km * 1000 <= v_radius then 'ELIGIBLE'
              when k.road_km is null and public.geolock_road_component(v_n.road_node_id)
                   is distinct from public.geolock_road_component(t.pickup_road_node_id)
              then 'ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE'
              else 'OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE' end
    from targets t
    left join costs k on k.target_node = t.pickup_road_node_id::bigint
  on conflict (listing_id, ngo_user_id) do update
    set network_snapshot_id = excluded.network_snapshot_id,
        ngo_road_node_id = excluded.ngo_road_node_id,
        listing_road_node_id = excluded.listing_road_node_id,
        road_distance_km = excluded.road_distance_km,
        geofence_radius_m = excluded.geofence_radius_m,
        outcome = excluded.outcome,
        computed_at = clock_timestamp();
end

declare
  v_donation public.donations%rowtype; v_latest public.hub_reservations%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'UNAUTHENTICATED'; end if;
  select d.* into v_donation
  from public.donations d
  where d.donation_id = p_donation and d.donor_user_id = auth.uid();
  if not found then raise exception 'DONATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; end if;

  if v_donation.collection_path <> 'HUB_COLLECTION'
     or v_donation.donation_status not in ('SUBMITTED','HUB_ASSIGNED') then
    raise exception 'DONATION_NOT_HUB_ELIGIBLE';
  end if;
  if v_donation.donation_status='HUB_ASSIGNED' then
    select * into v_latest from public.hub_reservations r
    where r.donation_id=p_donation
    order by r.reserved_at desc,r.reservation_id desc limit 1;
    if v_latest.reservation_id is null or exists(select 1 from public.hub_reservations r
        where r.donation_id=p_donation and r.reservation_status in ('RELEASED','CONSUMED'))
      or exists(select 1 from public.hub_reservations r where r.donation_id=p_donation
          and r.reservation_status='EXPIRED' and r.expires_at>clock_timestamp())
      or (select count(*) from public.hub_reservations r
          where r.donation_id=p_donation and r.reservation_status='ACTIVE')>1
      or (v_latest.reservation_status='EXPIRED' and exists(
          select 1 from public.hub_reservations r where r.donation_id=p_donation
            and r.reservation_status='ACTIVE'))
      or not (
      v_latest.reservation_status='EXPIRED'
      or (v_latest.reservation_status='ACTIVE'
          and v_latest.expires_at<=statement_timestamp())
    ) then raise exception 'HUB_RESERVATION_NOT_EXPIRED'; end if;
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.hub_receipts r where r.donation_id=p_donation)
     or exists (select 1 from public.hub_inventory i where i.donation_id=p_donation)
     or exists (select 1 from public.hub_batch_members m
                where m.donation_id=p_donation and m.membership_status='ACTIVE') then
    raise exception 'DONATION_HAS_PHYSICAL_CUSTODY';
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.hub_reservations r
             where r.donation_id=p_donation
               and r.reservation_status='ACTIVE'
               and r.expires_at > statement_timestamp()) then
    raise exception 'HUB_RESERVATION_STILL_ACTIVE';
  end if;

  return query
  with hub_usage as (
    select h.hub_id,
      coalesce((select sum(hr.received_weight_kg)
        from public.hub_inventory hi join public.hub_receipts hr using(donation_id)
        where hi.hub_id=h.hub_id
          and hi.inventory_status in ('STORED','BATCHED','RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED')),0)
      + coalesce((select sum(r.reserved_weight_kg)
        from public.hub_reservations r
        where r.hub_id=h.hub_id and r.reservation_status='ACTIVE'
          and r.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          and not exists(select 1 from public.hub_receipts hr
                         where hr.reservation_id=r.reservation_id)),0) as used_kg
    from public.community_hubs h
  )
  select h.hub_id,h.hub_name,h.address_text,h.latitude,h.longitude,
         h.capacity_kg,greatest(0,h.capacity_kg-u.used_kg)::numeric
  from public.community_hubs h join hub_usage u using(hub_id)
  join public.geolock_donation_hub_routes(p_donation) rt using(hub_id)
  where h.active_flag
    and u.used_kg+v_donation.total_weight_kg<=h.capacity_kg
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.donation_items i
      where i.donation_id=p_donation
        and not exists(select 1 from public.hub_accepted_categories a
                       where a.hub_id=h.hub_id and a.category_id=i.category_id)
    )
  order by rt.road_km,h.hub_name;
end;

declare v_user uuid:=auth.uid(); v_role text; v_allowed boolean:=false;
begin
  if v_user is null then raise exception 'UNAUTHENTICATED'; end if;
  select p.role into v_role from public.user_profiles p where p.user_id=v_user;
  if v_role='DONOR' then
    v_allowed:=exists(select 1 from public.donations d where d.donor_user_id=v_user
      and (d.donation_id=p_entity_id or exists(select 1 from public.listings l
      where l.donation_id=d.donation_id and l.listing_id=p_entity_id)));
  elsif v_role='NGO' then
    v_allowed:=exists(select 1 from public.donation_claims c join public.listings l using(listing_id)
      where c.ngo_user_id=v_user and (c.claim_id=p_entity_id or l.listing_id=p_entity_id or l.donation_id=p_entity_id or (l.source_type='HUB_BATCH' and exists(
        select 1 from public.hub_batch_members bm where bm.batch_id=l.batch_id and bm.donation_id=p_entity_id))))
      or exists(select 1 from public.claim_requests q where q.ngo_user_id=v_user and q.listing_id=p_entity_id)
      or exists(select 1 from public.operation_failure_events f where f.operation_name='claim_listing'
        and f.details->>'rollback_confirmed'='true' and f.details->>'software_version'='geolock-claim-audit-v1'
        and f.actor_user_id=v_user and (f.listing_id=p_entity_id or f.donation_id=p_entity_id
          or f.details->'donation_ids' @> jsonb_build_array(p_entity_id)));
  elsif v_role='HUB_ADMIN' then
    v_allowed:=exists(select 1 from public.community_hubs h where h.admin_user_id=v_user
      and (h.hub_id=p_entity_id or exists(select 1 from public.hub_reservations r
      where r.hub_id=h.hub_id and r.donation_id=p_entity_id) or exists(select 1 from public.hub_inventory i
      where i.hub_id=h.hub_id and i.donation_id=p_entity_id)));
  end if;
  if not v_allowed then raise exception 'AUDIT_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; end if;
  return query select events.* from (select a.* from public.audit_events a
    where (a.entity_id=p_entity_id or a.details->>'donation_id'=p_entity_id::text
      or a.details->>'listing_id'=p_entity_id::text or a.claim_id=p_entity_id
      or a.details->'donation_ids' @> jsonb_build_array(p_entity_id))
      and (v_role<>'NGO' or (a.event_type<>'DONOR_PRIVATE_DATA' and
       (a.actor_user_id=v_user or exists(select 1 from public.donation_claims own
         where own.claim_id=a.claim_id and own.ngo_user_id=v_user))))

  -- Read-only projection of confirmed rollback evidence; historical rows stay in their original ledger.
  -- NGO access is actor-scoped; no claim ownership is inferred from a failed request.
  union all select (jsonb_populate_record(null::public.audit_events,jsonb_build_object(
    'event_id',f.failure_id,'actor_user_id',f.actor_user_id,'actor_role',f.actor_role,
    'entity_type','LISTING','entity_id',f.listing_id,'event_type','CLAIM_FAILURE',
    'request_id',f.request_id,'claim_id',f.claim_id,'lease_id',null,
    'correlation_id',case when f.details->>'correlation_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      then f.details->>'correlation_id' else null end,
    'previous_state',f.details->>'previous_state','requested_state',f.details->>'requested_state',
    'resulting_state',f.details->>'resulting_state','reason_code',f.reason_code,'outcome','ERROR',
    'details',f.details||jsonb_build_object('audit_source','operation_failure_events',
      'donation_id',f.donation_id,'listing_id',f.listing_id,'ngo_id',f.actor_user_id),
    'software_version',f.details->>'software_version','configuration_version',f.details->>'configuration_version',
    'occurred_at',f.occurred_at))).*
  from public.operation_failure_events f where f.operation_name='claim_listing'
   and f.details->>'rollback_confirmed'='true' and f.details->>'software_version'='geolock-claim-audit-v1'
   and (f.listing_id=p_entity_id or f.donation_id=p_entity_id or f.claim_id=p_entity_id
     or f.details->'donation_ids' @> jsonb_build_array(p_entity_id))
   and (v_role<>'NGO' or f.actor_user_id=v_user)
  ) events order by events.occurred_at,events.event_id;
end;

declare v_result jsonb;
begin

    'pickup_address',d.pickup_address,'latitude',d.latitude,'longitude',d.longitude,
    'availability_start',d.availability_start,'availability_end',d.availability_end,
    'created_at',d.created_at,'updated_at',d.updated_at,
    'listing_status',l.listing_status,
    'road_node_status',case when l.listing_id is null then null
      when l.pickup_road_node_id is null then case when public.geolock_active_road_snapshot() is null then 'PENDING_NODE' else 'NOT_ROUTABLE' end else 'READY' end,
    'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'item_id',i.item_id,'category_id',i.category_id,'category',c.category_name,
      'item_name',i.item_name,'description',i.description,'quantity',i.quantity,
      'unit_label',i.unit_label,'unit_weight_kg',i.unit_weight_kg,
      'item_condition',i.item_condition) order by i.created_at,i.item_id)
      from public.donation_items i join public.donation_categories c using(category_id)
      where i.donation_id=d.donation_id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'hub_reservations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'reservation_id',r.reservation_id,'hub_id',r.hub_id,'hub_name',h.hub_name,
      'status',r.reservation_status,
      'effective_status',case when r.reservation_status='ACTIVE'
        and r.expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'EXPIRED'
        else r.reservation_status end,
      'reserved_weight_kg',r.reserved_weight_kg,'reserved_at',r.reserved_at,
      'expires_at',r.expires_at,'receipt_status',hr.receipt_status,
      'received_weight_kg',hr.received_weight_kg,'received_at',hr.received_at)
      order by r.reserved_at desc,r.reservation_id desc)
      from public.hub_reservations r join public.community_hubs h using(hub_id)
      left join public.hub_receipts hr on hr.reservation_id=r.reservation_id
      where r.donation_id=d.donation_id),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result
  from public.donations d
  left join lateral (
    select dl.* from public.listings dl
    where (dl.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' and dl.donation_id=d.donation_id)
      or (dl.source_type='HUB_BATCH' and exists(select 1 from public.hub_batch_members m
        where m.batch_id=dl.batch_id and m.donation_id=d.donation_id and m.membership_status='ACTIVE'))

DECLARE actor uuid := auth.uid(); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- Identical denial for absent, foreign, null, non-donor and unauthenticated input.
 IF actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.donations d
  JOIN public.donor_profiles dp ON dp.user_id=d.donor_user_id
  JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.user_id=dp.user_id AND u.role='DONOR'
  WHERE d.donation_id=p_donation AND d.donor_user_id=actor
 ) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='DONATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN';
 END IF;

 -- One stable MVCC snapshot. Never depend on removable active assignments.
 WITH history AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.claim_id,t.task_id,b.route_id,b.created_at,
   c.claim_status,le.lease_status,t.task_status,pr.route_status,
   rc.case_id,rc.version AS case_version,rc.status AS resolution_status,
   rc.resolved_at,ri.initial_class,cc.case_status AS claim_reconciliation_status,
   cc.resolved_at AS claim_resolved_at,rel.disposition,rel.released_at,
   (c.listing_id=t.listing_id AND c.ngo_user_id=b.ngo_id
    AND pr.ngo_user_id=b.ngo_id AND le.claim_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (cc.case_id IS NULL OR (cc.listing_id=l.listing_id
      AND cc.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' AND cc.donation_id=p_donation)) AND
    (rc.case_id IS NULL OR (rc.ngo_id=b.ngo_id AND ri.claim_id=c.claim_id
      AND ri.source_actor=actor AND ri.source_role='DONOR'))) IS TRUE AS binding_valid,
   CASE WHEN rc.case_id IS NOT NULL THEN rc.status<>'RESOLVED'
    ELSE b.closed_at IS NULL AND it.released_at IS NULL
      AND t.task_status IN ('PLANNED','DISPATCHED') END AS unresolved,
   b.ngo_id
  FROM public.listings l
  JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.listing_id=l.listing_id
  JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=c.claim_id
  JOIN routing_private.items it ON it.task_id=t.task_id
  JOIN routing_private.bindings b ON b.route_id=it.route_id
  JOIN public.pickup_routes pr ON pr.route_id=b.route_id
  LEFT JOIN resolution_private.cases rc ON rc.route_id=b.route_id
  LEFT JOIN resolution_private.items ri ON ri.case_id=rc.case_id AND ri.task_id=t.task_id
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_reconciliation_cases cc ON cc.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN resolution_private.releases rel ON rel.case_id=rc.case_id AND rel.task_id=t.task_id
  WHERE l.donation_id=p_donation AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
 ), scope AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE unresolved) AS unresolved_count,
   coalesce(bool_and(binding_valid),true) AS valid FROM history
 ), bounded AS (
  SELECT * FROM history ORDER BY created_at DESC,route_id,task_id LIMIT 20
 ), decorated AS (
  SELECT h.*, de.assertion AS donor_assertion,de.version AS donor_version,
   de.created_at AS donor_submitted_at,ne.assertion AS ngo_assertion,
   ne.version AS ngo_version,ne.created_at AS ngo_submitted_at,
   CASE WHEN s.total>20 THEN 'HISTORY_TRUNCATED'
    WHEN NOT s.valid THEN 'ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT'
    WHEN s.unresolved_count>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_UNRESOLVED_ASSOCIATIONS'
    WHEN NOT cfg.enabled THEN 'RESOLUTION_DISABLED'
    WHEN h.case_id IS NULL THEN 'AWAITING_NGO_REPORT'
    WHEN h.resolution_status='RESOLVED' THEN 'TERMINAL_READ_ONLY'
    WHEN h.initial_class NOT IN ('NEVER_STARTED','DISPATCHED')
      OR h.task_status NOT IN ('PLANNED','DISPATCHED')
      OR h.claim_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
      OR h.lease_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
      OR coalesce(h.claim_reconciliation_status,'') NOT IN ('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')
      THEN 'PICKUP_STATE_REQUIRES_REVIEW'
    ELSE NULL END AS blocker
  FROM bounded h CROSS JOIN scope s CROSS JOIN resolution_private.config cfg
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT e.assertion,e.version,e.created_at FROM resolution_private.evidence e
   WHERE h.binding_valid AND e.case_id=h.case_id AND e.task_id=h.task_id
    AND e.actor_id=actor ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1
  ) de ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT e.assertion,e.version,e.created_at FROM resolution_private.evidence e
   WHERE h.binding_valid AND e.case_id=h.case_id AND e.task_id=h.task_id
    AND e.actor_id=h.ngo_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1
  ) ne ON true
  WHERE cfg.singleton
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'contract','geolock.donor-route-resolution.v1','donation_id',p_donation,

  'history_truncated',s.total>20,'association_conflict',NOT s.valid OR s.unresolved_count>1,

 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v->'stops') s(value)
 JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.task_id=(s.value->>'task_id')::uuid
 JOIN routing_private.items i ON i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.route_id=p_route
 JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.claim_id=t.claim_id JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=t.claim_id
 LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=p_route AND d.task_id=t.task_id;
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED')
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items i JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id) JOIN public.donation_claims c USING(claim_id) JOIN public.claim_leases le USING(claim_id)
   LEFT JOIN routing_private.deferred_stops d ON d.route_id=i.route_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id WHERE i.route_id=p_route
   AND NOT ((i.collected_at IS NOT NULL AND t.task_status='COLLECTED' AND c.claim_status='COMPLETED' AND le.lease_status='COMPLETED')
    OR (d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED' AND i.released_at IS NOT NULL AND t.task_status='STALE' AND c.claim_status='RELEASED' AND le.lease_status='RELEASED')))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.active_task_route_assignments a JOIN public.pickup_tasks at USING(task_id) JOIN routing_private.items ai USING(route_id,task_id) WHERE a.route_id=p_route AND NOT(at.task_status='COLLECTED' AND ai.collected_at IS NOT NULL))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolution_private.cases rc WHERE rc.route_id=p_route AND rc.status IN('AWAITING_EVIDENCE','MANUAL_REVIEW'))
 INTO mixed_ready;
 v:=v||jsonb_build_object('stops',stops,'next_executable_task_id',next_id,'dispatch_block_reason',CASE WHEN ok THEN NULL WHEN blocked IS NOT NULL THEN to_jsonb(blocked) ELSE v->'dispatch_block_reason' END,
  'can_close',(v->'authorization_confirmed'='true'::jsonb) AND (coalesce((v->>'can_close')::boolean,false) OR mixed_ready),
  'can_cancel',coalesce((v->>'can_cancel')::boolean,false) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route),
  'closure_outcome',CASE WHEN mixed_ready THEN 'ABANDONED' WHEN coalesce((v->>'can_close')::boolean,false) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE NULL END,
  'awaiting_individual_reconciliation',next_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='DEFERRED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.items i JOIN public.pickup_tasks t USING(task_id) WHERE i.route_id=p_route AND i.released_at IS NULL AND i.collected_at IS NULL AND t.task_status<>'DISPATCHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=i.route_id AND d.task_id=i.task_id AND d.status='DEFERRED')),
  'has_resolved_uncollected',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM routing_private.deferred_stops d WHERE d.route_id=p_route AND d.status='RESOLVED_UNCOLLECTED'));
 RETURN v;
END

DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.donations d JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.user_id=d.donor_user_id
  JOIN public.donor_profiles dp ON dp.user_id=d.donor_user_id
  WHERE d.donation_id=p_donation AND d.donor_user_id=actor AND u.role='DONOR')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='DONATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;

 WITH history AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.claim_id,c.ngo_user_id,c.claim_status,l.listing_id,l.listing_status,l.source_type,
   d.donation_id,d.title,le.lease_status,le.expires_at,t.task_id,t.task_status,
   i.route_id,rc.case_id,rc.case_status,rc.opened_at,rc.resolved_at,
   (c.listing_id=l.listing_id AND l.donation_id=p_donation AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
    AND d.donor_user_id=actor AND t.claim_id=c.claim_id AND t.listing_id=l.listing_id
    AND le.claim_id=c.claim_id AND (rc.case_id IS NULL OR
     (rc.claim_id=c.claim_id AND rc.listing_id=l.listing_id AND rc.donation_id=p_donation AND rc.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'))) IS TRUE AS binding_valid
  FROM public.donations d
  JOIN public.listings l ON l.donation_id=d.donation_id AND l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION'
  JOIN public.donation_claims c ON c.listing_id=l.listing_id
  JOIN public.pickup_tasks t ON t.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_leases le ON le.claim_id=c.claim_id
  LEFT JOIN routing_private.items i ON i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.released_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN public.claim_reconciliation_cases rc ON rc.claim_id=c.claim_id
  WHERE d.donation_id=p_donation AND d.donor_user_id=actor
 ), scoped AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE case_status IN('OPEN','MANUAL_REVIEW')) AS open_count,
   coalesce(bool_and(binding_valid),true) AS all_valid FROM history
 ), decorated AS (
  SELECT h.*,de.handover_confirmed AS donor_handover,de.submitted_at AS donor_submitted_at,
   de.response AS donor_response,ne.handover_confirmed AS ngo_handover,ne.submitted_at AS ngo_submitted_at,
   ne.response AS ngo_response,
   CASE
    WHEN s.total>20 THEN 'HISTORY_TRUNCATED'
    WHEN NOT s.all_valid THEN 'ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT'
    WHEN s.open_count>1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_OPEN_CLAIM_CASES'
    WHEN case_status IN('RESOLVED_COLLECTED','RESOLVED_RELEASED') THEN 'RESOLVED_READ_ONLY'
    WHEN case_id IS NULL AND claim_status='ACTIVE' AND lease_status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN 'WAITING_FOR_EXPIRY_RECOVERY'
    WHEN case_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_OPEN_RECONCILIATION'
    WHEN case_status<>'OPEN' THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW_OR_TERMINAL'
    WHEN claim_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' OR lease_status<>'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'
     OR listing_status<>'CLAIMED' OR task_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','PLANNED','DISPATCHED','COLLECTED') THEN 'PICKUP_STATE_REQUIRES_REVIEW'
    WHEN de.request_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DONOR_EVIDENCE_ALREADY_RECORDED'
    ELSE NULL END AS blocker
  FROM history h CROSS JOIN scoped s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.request_id,e.handover_confirmed,e.submitted_at,e.response FROM public.claim_reconciliation_evidence e
   WHERE e.case_id=h.case_id AND e.actor_user_id=actor ORDER BY e.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1) de ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.handover_confirmed,e.submitted_at,e.response FROM public.claim_reconciliation_evidence e
   WHERE e.case_id=h.case_id AND e.actor_user_id=h.ngo_user_id ORDER BY e.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1) ne ON true
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('contract','geolock.donor-claim-reconciliation.v1','donation_id',p_donation,
  'title',(SELECT title FROM public.donations WHERE donation_id=p_donation),'server_now',statement_timestamp(),
  'history_truncated',s.total>20,'association_conflict',NOT s.all_valid OR s.open_count>1,
  'contexts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'donation_id',x.donation_id,'claim_id',x.claim_id,'listing_id',x.listing_id,'task_id',x.task_id,'route_id',x.route_id,
   'case_id',x.case_id,'case_status',x.case_status,'opened_at',x.opened_at,'resolved_at',x.resolved_at,
   'claim_status',x.claim_status,'lease_status',x.lease_status,'lease_expires_at',x.expires_at,
   'task_status',x.task_status,'source_type',x.source_type,'can_submit_evidence',x.blocker IS NULL,
   'blocking_reason',x.blocker,
   'donor_evidence',jsonb_build_object('handover_confirmed',x.donor_handover,'submitted_at',x.donor_submitted_at,'response',x.donor_response),
   'ngo_evidence',jsonb_build_object('handover_confirmed',x.ngo_handover,'submitted_at',x.ngo_submitted_at,'response',x.ngo_response),
   'allowed_assertions',CASE WHEN x.blocker IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_array('COLLECTED','NOT_COLLECTED') ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) ORDER BY x.opened_at DESC NULLS LAST,x.claim_id) FROM decorated x),'[]'::jsonb))
 INTO result FROM scoped s;
 RETURN result;
END

DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); r record;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR p_request IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AUTHENTICATION_AND_REQUEST_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 SELECT e.request_id,e.case_id,e.actor_user_id,e.handover_confirmed,e.response,cl.claim_id,l.source_type
 INTO r FROM public.claim_reconciliation_evidence e JOIN public.claim_reconciliation_cases c USING(case_id)
 JOIN public.donation_claims cl ON cl.claim_id=c.claim_id JOIN public.listings l ON l.listing_id=cl.listing_id
 LEFT JOIN public.donations d ON d.donation_id=l.donation_id
 LEFT JOIN public.hub_batches hb ON hb.batch_id=l.batch_id LEFT JOIN public.community_hubs h USING(hub_id)
 JOIN public.user_profiles u ON u.user_id=actor
 WHERE e.request_id=p_request AND e.actor_user_id=actor AND
  ((u.role='NGO' AND cl.ngo_user_id=actor) OR
   (l.source_type='DIRECT_DONATION' AND u.role='DONOR' AND d.donor_user_id=actor) OR
   (l.source_type='HUB_BATCH' AND u.role='HUB_ADMIN' AND h.admin_user_id=actor));
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('found',false,'request_id',p_request); END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('found',true,'request_id',r.request_id,'case_id',r.case_id,'claim_id',r.claim_id,
  'handover_confirmed',r.handover_confirmed,'result',r.response);
END
